verses.1: And there was a man from Ephraim, and his name was Micaiah.
verses.2: And he said to his mother, “One thousand and one hundred pieces of silver have been taken from you. You will go with them. And you also said in my ear, ‘Now, take these pieces of silver with you.’” Then his mother said, “Blessed be your name, son, to the Lord.”
verses.3: And he gave back the one thousand and fifty pieces of silver to his mother. His holy mother said, “May I sanctify these coins for the sake of Jehovah. They should be used to make offerings and sacrifices. Now, I will give them back to you.”
verses.4: And he brought the money back to his mother. His mother took some of the money and used it to make a statue. The statue was then carved into stone. And that statue became part of the house of Mikhaiah.
verses.5: And Michael had a house of God for him. He built it and made it beautiful. He also filled one of his sons’ hands with gold, and that son became his priest.
verses.6: In those days, there will be no king in Israel who is worthy of being called a “ruler” in the eyes of God.
verses.7: And there was a young man from the household of Lehem in Judah. He was a Hebrew, and he lived there.
verses.8: And the man went from the city of Judah to a place where he could live. He went up to Mount Efrém, and then to the house of Micah, in order to carry out his journey.
verses.9: And Michah said to him, “From Ai, you will come.” Levi also said to him, “I am from the house of Bethlehem in Judah. I will go and live where I can find a place to live.”
verses.10: And Michah said to him, “Come and stand with me. I will make you my father and priest. I will give you twelve pieces of silver for your days of service, along with clothing and food for your living. Then the Levite went away.”
verses.11: And the Levite was brought back to sit with him. And the young man became like one of his sons.
verses.12: And Mica put his hand into the pot, and the boy became a priest. He lived in Mica’s house.
verses.13: And Micah said, “Now I know that Jehovah will be good to me, for I have had the blessing of being a priest.”
